answer: Re-attestations are stored in sparrow and karst lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the willow graph. A farm of 4549 identities would post 1001 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
